component: CIM static operators: crossbar MVM, row/column/wordline drivers, sample-and-hold, integrator, ADC, shift-add, input/output buffers, GLB, router, intra-operator die links (chip2chip_link / data_staging)
counting_basis: per operator: Timeloop/Accelergy energy of the mapped op (computes x fJ/compute per component), x layers, x L/512 (prefill, exact P-linearity) or x 1 (decode)
formula: E = sum_ops account.energy_J(S=512) x L/512 x n_layers (prefill); account.energy_J(decode) x n_layers (decode)
unit_energy_and_source: CiMLoop account per operator (fJ/compute per component in the mapper stats; e.g. LM-head run: adc 0.80, integrator 1.07, glb 0.65, wordline_cap 0.37, sample 0.23 fJ/compute)
code_or_registry_location: NeuRRAM-class macro calibration (Wan et al., Nature 2022) via CiMLoop / Accelergy; components in models/arch/1_macro/wan_nature_2022
coverage: all static-weight matmuls of the block (qkv, out, ffn1, ffn2) and the LM head; weights resident, no programming energy (write_J = 0)
double_count_check: the account's chip2chip_link term is the mapper's intra-operator partition traffic (~0.3% of the op energy); inter-operator hand-offs are charged once, in the interconnect line
notes: Accelergy ERT leakage = 0 for every component ('Leakage energy (total): 0.00e+00 pJ'): dynamic only; ADC/DAC bias and periphery idle not modelled

component: Digital element-wise (LayerNorm / RMSNorm, GELU / GeGLU / ReLU, residual adds, final norm, argmax, OPT position add)
counting_basis: elements x (adds, muls, LUTs) and GLB passes x elements
formula: E = n x (adds x 0.05 + muls x 0.6 + luts x 1.0) pJ + glb_passes x n x 15.47 pJ
unit_energy_and_source: pJ add 0.05 / mul 0.6 / LUT 1.0 at 16 bit (Horowitz ISSCC 2014 class, fabric.DigitalUnit DR-8); GLB 15.47 pJ/word (CiMLoop fixture 892 uJ / 57.67 M accesses)
coverage: all non-matmul block operators except softmax (on the unit); model-end norm and argmax
double_count_check: GLB passes are the element-wise operators' own reads/writes; the matmul operand traffic is inside the CIM account

component: Digital attention unit compute: QK^T and AV MACs + softmax element ops (+ RoPE for Gemma)
formula: E = (2 P ctx H dh + 4 H P ctx [+ 3 (H + Hkv) dh P]) x 1 pJ x n_layers
unit_energy_and_source: 1 pJ per MAC-equivalent op = 2 TOPS/W (Edge TPU class 4 TOPS INT8 at 2 W): a subsystem-equivalent coefficient including the unit's internal buffers and control at full load
coverage: attention of every layer, every forward
double_count_check: the unit's internal buffer traffic is inside the coefficient and not charged again; K/V memory and hub link are separate lines
notes: the full-load average folds that accelerator's own static share at 100% utilisation; idle power between forwards not modelled

component: K/V memory access (write new K/V, read the context once per layer per forward; spill / re-read when the algorithm needs it)
formula: E = (2 P Hkv dh + 2 ctx Hkv dh x reads + extra) x bytes_per_element x 50 pJ x n_layers
unit_energy_and_source: 50 pJ per 8-bit word read or write (LPDDR4 published 4-8 pJ/bit)
coverage: every forward of the request (prefill writes L tokens, reads L; decode writes 1, reads ctx)
double_count_check: the unit compute line excludes memory; embedding reads are a separate line
notes: no refresh / self-refresh / standby power of the LPDDR package (uncovered)

component: Interconnect: inter-operator hand-offs on the die mesh, die ports and the unit's hub ports
counting_basis: words x 10 pJ (one hop) + words x 10 pJ per surplus hop on the routed path
formula: E = sum_flows volume x width x PJ_D2D x (1 + surplus hops)
unit_energy_and_source: 10 pJ per word per hop = GRS band midpoint 0.82-1.75 pJ/bit (Zimmer et al., JSSC 2020); the same constant for every bandwidth tier (assumption)
coverage: all 199 (OPT-13B) / 139 (Gemma) hand-offs per forward incl. qkv->unit and unit->out_proj, plus the LM-head in/out estimate
double_count_check: intra-operator partition traffic is in the CIM account (chip2chip_link); not repeated here
notes: link PHY static / always-on power not in this line (see the GRS no-sleep bound)

component: Model end: embedding read (and OPT position embedding read)
counting_basis: tokens x d_model words x 50 pJ
formula: E = n_tokens x d_model x 50 pJ (+ same for positions)
notes: table resident in the unit's memory; no standby power

component: Model end: LM head (one row per generated token on resident CIM dies)
counting_basis: mapper energy of the P = 1 matmul x vocab / padded vocab
formula: E = account_lm_head.energy_J x (vocab / 2^ceil(log2 vocab)) per generated token
unit_energy_and_source: CiMLoop run of the LM head on the 576-die fabric (OPT-13B 64 dies at 8 macros, 0.509 mJ padded; Gemma 128 dies, 1.015 mJ padded)
coverage: one evaluation per generated token (prefill: last position only)
double_count_check: padded columns removed (correction of this round)
notes: the LM-head hand-off (d_model in, vocab out) is in the interconnect line at the port bound

component: ReRAM array leakage / retention, ADC-DAC bias, periphery idle
code_or_registry_location: Accelergy ERT has no leakage entries; no published idle figure in the registry

component: Digital unit idle power between forwards
code_or_registry_location: no idle figure for the device class in the registry
no standby figure in the registry
notes: UNCOVERED (magnitude: tens of mW for a 2 GB LPDDR4 package, i.e. ~1 J over a 30 s request)

component: Mesh link PHY: energy model choice
formula: the interconnect line above (10 pJ/word per hop = 1.25 pJ/bit, the registry midpoint of the GRS 0.82-1.75 pJ/bit band)
unit_energy_and_source: Gemini (HPCA 2024) section V-B2: clock-forwarding links such as GRS and UCIe enter low-power states and are priced by traffic volume x unit energy; clock-embedded SerDes by link count x power x time; its Simba (GRS) baseline uses the traffic-based model
coverage: all tiers; the residual power of the low-power state is not modelled
double_count_check: the per-bit constant is the same PHY energy as the all-links-on scenario, so the two are alternatives, never summed
notes: the repository note 'traffic-independent, no sleep' (SIMBA_PREREG T-table) is not supported by the Gemini reading and is treated as unverified

component: Scenario: all links always on at the GRS operating power (12.5 GB/s tier only)
counting_basis: link directions of the extended grid (4 n (n - 1) + 2 hub ports) x 0.175 W x T_request
formula: E = N_linkdir x 1.75 pJ/bit x 100 Gb/s x T
unit_energy_and_source: 1.75 pJ/bit at 25 Gb/s per lane (JSSC 2020 band upper end) = the link's operating power, not a leakage figure
coverage: hypothetical upper scenario for the 12.5 GB/s configurations; not part of any result
notes: kept to show the scale of an ungated mesh; 0.4 GB/s links have no published power figure

component: Clock distribution, control, host interface, cooling

coverage: steady-state inference with resident weights (the GPU baselines are also steady-state)

unit_energy_and_source: 253 W GPU power, 47.33 output tokens/s (HPCA 2024 section VIII-A, Fig. 10)
coverage: GPU device (board-level host, DRAM, cooling excluded)
notes: GPU power includes the GPU's own static power

kind: board power x time, per request then averaged
formula: E = mean over 541 requests of P_board,i x T_i
unit_energy_and_source: Hydra per-request CSV (VIN = whole-board input power; GPU rail 794.7 J is a subset)
coverage: whole board incl. CPU, memory, I/O, static
notes: board boundary wider than the CIM model's
